bibl.title: Una lettera di Reinhold Merkelbach a Vittorio Bartoletti sui papiri ercolanesi.
bibl.seg: Anna Di Giglio, Una lettera di Reinhold Merkelbach a Vittorio Bartoletti sui papiri ercolanesi.
Philosophical Papyri. A Journal of Ancient Philosophy and the Papyrological Tradition 1 (2023) pp. 169-176.
bibl.note: Transcription of and explanatory notes on an epistolary exchange between R. Merkelbach and V. Bartoletti as well as a letter of the former to F. Sbordone about the attempts of A. Fackelmann at unrolling Herculaneum papyri through electromagnetic methods.
